name: Lydia A. Moore
mentions: Mrs. Lydia A. Moore returned from Minneapolis Sunday night, whence she was recalled by the accident to her son, Hayes.

…to help anyone and who never had an enemy.  He was born in Steubenville, Ohio, the eldest son of Geo. D. and Lydia A. Moore and at the time of his death was thirty-eight years old. He came to this place in 1879 as clerk for his brother Frank, who at that time was sutler at the Canton…
